chartEmptyPolicy: null retained; no synthetic zero/fifty fallback; observed score0..10 and mastery0..1 distinct charts; cognitive values require sample_count>0
readOnlySafety: No app import, .env, production DB, provider call or data POST performed by this static check.

migration.chartModule: Full replacement; four legacy hex colors removed; external Chart.js source replaced by local versioned asset.

designDecisions: S16: class GET context before one server-state primary action; teacher papers secondary; evidence disclosure retains shared 8x4 knowledge matrix.
S16: resume means reopening the paper, explicitly no answer restoration/autosave promise.
S17: subject context first; cold start and unknown stay neutral; KPI average and best score require actual attempts.
S17: observed score 0–10, snapshot mastery0–1 and cognitive weighted rate0–100 use separate charts with local token colors.
S17: null and unknown gaps remain null, all data tables and result links survive chart-load failure.
S17: fewer than four chart points remain points without a connected trend; trend labels follow backend only when >=3 attempts.
